# EE 120: curriculum

<!-- Generated from curricula/ee-120.json by scripts/build.py. Do not edit: edit the JSON. -->

**ELENG 120: Signals and Systems.** Tier 1. Scope taken from FA26.

Built from:

- Homework 1 to 10 and discussions 1 to 11 of Fall 2026, which define the current scope
- 40 past exams from Spring 2015 to Fall 2026, tagged question by question

Notes:

- The course writes i for the imaginary unit and uses ω for both continuous and discrete frequency. This repo writes j.
- Fall 2026 examines state space (modes, Cayley-Hamilton, internal stability) alongside the usual signals material.
- Sampling, the Laplace transform and the z-transform had not appeared in homework by November 2026. Past exams put them in scope, so they are flagged not-yet-assessed and kept.
- The course's own conventions: Fourier series coefficients carry the 1/p on the analysis side; transforms are in ω with the 1/(2π) on the inverse; u(0) = 1.

## Mastery target

L4 on every concept marked 4 below, L3 on the rest. The levels and what counts as evidence are in [docs/levels.md](../docs/levels.md).

## Outline and coverage

Weight is how much a concept is assessed: an exam item counts 1, halved for every 4 years of age; a homework, discussion, lab or practice item counts 0.5 in the scope term and 0.25 before it. The identifiers name where it is assessed, so you can find the item in your own copy of the materials.
